## Summary

Add the source manual enemy rules and mapped slider primitive, continuing original491b002.

```text
local x −55…55 → quadratic fraction → integer life/reward or tenth speed
manual value → square-root inverse → twip-quantized handle
text draft → separate Number/clamp rules, defer trailing speed dot
```

Uses the native artwork cache merged in #66. Authored panel/field/checkbox/confirmation integration follows separately.

## Evidence

- Formatting, TypeScript,509 rule tests (6,181 assertions) and production build pass.
- All six affected native/mock browser cases pass across existing control/editor checks and the final two mapped-slider cases (9.2s). Resize/twin/undo behavior, valid loaded scale3 with paint at57, primary-release guard and cancellation remain verified.
- New browser cases cover imported0.515396 uniform scale, handle-only activation, life375 with retained cursor12.35 after dragging to12.37, reset, endpoint clamp, cancellation once, disabled inputs and keyboard Home/End. Both final captures were inspected.
- Manual limits, quadratic arithmetic, fractional text values, invalid/range clamps and trailing-dot drafts follow TankCreatorScreen's constructor and drag/text handlers. [Pinned Ruffle x setter](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/blob/89a7049965f3090e706265670df309a5128233ac/core/src/avm2/globals/flash/display/display_object.rs#L303-L313) and [Twips conversion](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/blob/89a7049965f3090e706265670df309a5128233ac/swf/src/types/twips.rs#L96-L98) support twentieth-pixel truncation and below-minimum square-root NaN handling; this is not an Adobe-runtime parity claim.
- Existing resize/rotation uses the unchanged default linear mapping and paint-only clamp. Optional coordinate conversion and disabled state are exercised in an isolated fixture; the current generic enemy inspector remains a compatibility bridge until the authored UI lands. Keyboard/cancellation remain browser adapters. No generated data/media/schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes optional mapping/manual helpers. Saved designs and suggestion arithmetic are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** controls

The shared slider accepts new optional behavior; existing callers retain their defaults.

input.body:
## Summary

Replace the generic enemy inspector with the authored panel and confirmation flow, completing the runtime UI slice of original491b002 after #63–67.

```text
Stats ↔ Enemy Info
suggested on → read-only fields
suggested off → manual fields +quadratic sliders
request suggestions → confirmation →Yes applies /No preserves
                                    →resume current playhead
```

Preserve existing save/import arithmetic and transient suggestion mode.

## Evidence

- Formatting, TypeScript,510 rule tests (6,184 assertions), production build and all12 final native/mock browser cases pass in2.4minutes without skips. The final two modal flows additionally pass36.9s after hiding the overlapping legacy Export aid.
- Browser checks cover source panel/field geometry, non-primary tab guards, readonly/manual values, trailing-dot speed drafts, sliders, No/Yes, save/reopen, stale suggestion save recomputation, placement/cancellation, palette validation and saved-copy medals. Final native/mock panel and confirmation captures were inspected.
- Source listeners activate when opening starts. A clock-controlled early response preserves the frame12 stop; Yes/No resume rather than force a closing jump. Closing/reopening the panel clears that state.
- Source913 has button cutouts. Numerical mock masks and two native open poses without the hovered button let rollover art replace normal art. Screen-pixel regressions verify source white alpha153 normal/57 rollover in both modes; the old mock rectangle approach fails by30 color levels. The expanded39-entry native gallery verifies both excluded-button cutouts are transparent.
- Uses the existing imported layout, font identity, native caches and manual rules. Palette actions close the advanced panel; accepted saving still recomputes enabled suggestions from the final geometry.
- Legacy JSON export hides only while confirmation is visible and returns afterwards. Original save/share dialogs, full Flash text/selection, complete constructor/event timing and controlled original-screen comparison remain pending. No source media, contours, generated data or saved-design schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the generic inspector; saved designs and source calculation helpers remain compatible.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Enemy panel rendering and input change. Avatar saving, placement, validation and medals are covered by the affected browser checks.

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:

  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

    name: Rules, build and mock browser
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2

      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run format:check
      - run: bun run check
      - run: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Production build and offline browser smoke
        run: bun run test:e2e --grep 'mock|synthetic'
      - name: Retain failed browser traces
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: browser-failures
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

output.body:
## Summary

Replace the generic enemy inspector with the authored panel and confirmation flow, completing the runtime UI slice of original491b002 after #63–67.

```text
Stats ↔ Enemy Info
suggested on → read-only fields
suggested off → manual fields +quadratic sliders
request suggestions → confirmation →Yes applies /No preserves
                                    →resume current playhead
```

Preserve existing save/import arithmetic and transient suggestion mode.

## Evidence

- Formatting, TypeScript,510 rule tests (6,184 assertions), production build and all12 final native/mock browser cases pass in2.4minutes without skips. The final two modal flows additionally pass36.9s after hiding the overlapping legacy Export aid.
- Browser checks cover source panel/field geometry, non-primary tab guards, readonly/manual values, trailing-dot speed drafts, sliders, No/Yes, save/reopen, stale suggestion save recomputation, placement/cancellation, palette validation and saved-copy medals. Final native/mock panel and confirmation captures were inspected.
- Source listeners activate when opening starts. A clock-controlled early response preserves the frame12 stop; Yes/No resume rather than force a closing jump. Closing/reopening the panel clears that state.
- Source913 has button cutouts. Numerical mock masks and two native open poses without the hovered button let rollover art replace normal art. Screen-pixel regressions verify source white alpha153 normal/57 rollover in both modes; the old mock rectangle approach fails by30 color levels. The expanded39-entry native gallery verifies both excluded-button cutouts are transparent.
- Uses the existing imported layout, font identity, native caches and manual rules. Palette actions close the advanced panel; accepted saving still recomputes enabled suggestions from the final geometry.
- Legacy JSON export hides only while confirmation is visible and returns afterwards. Original save/share dialogs, full Flash text/selection, complete constructor/event timing and controlled original-screen comparison remain pending. No source media, contours, generated data or saved-design schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the generic inspector; saved designs and source calculation helpers remain compatible.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Enemy panel rendering and input change. Avatar saving, placement, validation and medals are covered by the affected browser checks.
